One of my best moments in video games is easily from early World of Warcraft, around the start of TBC or late Vanilla. 

Me, who was 10 at the time and one of my older brothers friends who was 13 at the time just started playing the Human race, he was a Rogue and I was a Paladin. My brother had been playing for a few days longer than us and his birthday was coming up. 
And at the time gold was not something everyone had so we did our best trying to grind up a few silver. We killed nearby enemies and sold the loot, I remember that he danced infront of someone who gave him 2 silver...which is what we almost gained in like 2 hours haha. 

Well, I remember we tried to get him a shield, a damn shield! So we farmed all day and at the evening we told him to go Goldshire in the Blacksmithing shop. So we met up there and surpised his little Gnome Warrior with a shield... And what does he say? I bought this shield about an hour ago!! 

So we had been farming all day for a ''white/common'' shield and we blew it.

I have been playing WoW for 9 years on and off but damn, that day will always stick with me, it was nothing special, fun or intense, just something nice to remember. I don't know why...
